_comment: Firmware variants: the single source of truth for what each dashboard/picker variant builds and how it is signed. Read by prepare-build (packaged with the Lambda) and by raw_device_builder/codebuild/build-shared-firmware.sh (staged to the firmware bucket's source/), which builds every variant once per deployment into shared/<version>/. build_variant selects the sketch/port in buildspec.yml; signer_era null = unsigned (classical 1.0.0 is USB/trusted-flash only, never OTA).
